review_candidates.title: Power Platform Developer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Design, build, and enhance Model-driven Apps and Canvas Apps using reusable, scalable, and maintainable development patterns. Qualifications 5+ years of software development or low-code development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft Power Apps development in enterprise environments. Proven experience delivering production-ready Model-driven Apps and Canvas Apps using Power Fx, reusable components, responsive design, and maintainable development patterns.
eligibility_evidence: Company Description We are looking for an experienced Power Platform Solution Architect to join an international Agile delivery team.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned work packages, communicate risks and blockers proactively, and contribute effectively to an international engineering team.
Professional English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and collaborate effectively with international teams.
